_comment: Analysis parameters. Paths are NOT set here; they come from --base in run_pipeline.py.
_country_filter_help: Empty = all countries. Otherwise FIPS codes, e.g. ["LY", "EG", "TS"]. Cuts data size a lot.
_focus_countries_help: Countries exported for plots in the notebook. LY=Libya, EG=Egypt, TS=Tunisia, AG=Algeria (FIPS codes).
_baseline_help: Reference period for climatology/anomalies. The WMO standard is 1991-2020 if you download that range.
